output.reason: [ev-a6fc1c17efbb] lists only a bug fix: the login return_url now works with custom server paths. Nothing says anything fails, is rejected or needs operator action, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind: the post-login redirect now behaves differently and correctly. The evidence gives no basis for medium severity, since a fix that restores intended redirect behavior is low-impact, so I lowered the severity to low.

correction.statement: In Argo CD 3.0.0, a bug fix makes the login return_url work when Argo CD is served under a custom server path. Before this fix it did not work. The redirect after login now goes to the intended return URL. No operator action is required.

consequence.statement: Login return_url redirects now work when the server uses a custom path; before the fix they did not. Nothing fails, and operators may want to check that the post-login redirect behaves as expected.
